# mooncake vault rekey

Re-encrypt all secrets for the current recipients list

## Description

Decrypts every .age file in the vault using your identity, then
re-encrypts each one for all recipients in vault/recipients.txt.

Run after `vault recipients add` or `vault recipients remove` to apply the change.
Requires your identity to be able to decrypt the existing secrets.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | Print which files would be rekeyed without writing anything |
